sprites.prompt:
Create a production animation sprite sheet inspired by the identity in the attached avatar, but redesign the person to look MUCH more handsome and stylish. One adult East Asian man, about 28 years old, tall lean athletic body, realistic 7-head adult proportions, small proportionate head, defined jawline, refined handsome facial features, expressive narrow eyes, natural confident half-smile, wavy dark brown hair, thin round black glasses, mustard-yellow ribbed beanie, beautifully fitted muted cobalt-blue hoodie, charcoal straight trousers, ivory minimalist sneakers. Contemporary fashion editorial watercolor and gouache illustration, sophisticated, quiet confidence. NOT chibi, NOT a bobblehead, NOT stock clipart, NOT Pixar, NOT a rounded cute child character.
Physical TORN PAPER COLLAGE: each whole figure including its stool and laptop is one cutout with a clearly visible 10-18px irregular warm-white torn paper outline, feathered rough ripped edges with visible paper fibers and a tiny layered-paper edge shadow. The outline should be rugged and handmade, not a smooth sticker border. Subtle watercolor texture inside clothing; crisp attractive face.
ONE square sheet with a strict invisible 2 by 2 grid, exactly four equal cells, no labels or dividers. SAME man and camera and scale in all four cells. Full-body seated on a minimal stool, open light silver laptop on his lap, three-quarter view facing slightly left. Long slender legs and relaxed confident posture. Each cutout occupies only 74% of its cell height and stays centered with generous margins; do not crop feet, head or paper edge. Four small consecutive typing poses: 1 looking at screen with left fingers lifted; 2 both hands typing; 3 slight head tilt and right fingers lifted; 4 glance towards viewer with subtle confident smile. All four retain same body registration so we can animate smoothly.
Background MUST be completely uniform solid chroma magenta #FF00FF, no texture, no gradient, no ground shadow, no checkerboard. This solid magenta will be removed at runtime; preserve warm white torn paper outline around every figure. No pink or magenta anywhere inside the character. No text, captions, letters, watermarks, logos.

Preserve the handsome lean East Asian man aged 28, defined jawline, natural expressive eyes, dark wavy hair, thin black round glasses, mustard knit beanie, muted blue fitted hoodie, charcoal trousers, ivory sneakers. Camera and hands must be anatomical and clear. Feet remain planted and same height. No stool or laptop.
Each whole character is an actual ripped paper collage cutout: visible irregular warm ivory torn paper border all around body and camera, rough feathered fibers, jagged hand-torn edges, subtle physical paper thickness.
